inner_split_rule: 20261224 + repeat_index*10 + fold; stratified 20 percent outer-fit patient groups
evaluation: Original training patients only. Fixed convex weights selected before these new outer outcomes. No new weight search on these folds.
confirmation_gate: Keep milestone5 unless the fixed raw expert mixture improves mean repeated macro-F1 and its exploratory patient-cluster paired macro-F1 95 percent interval lower bound exceeds zero. Compare raw/up at the identical fixed weight; make no raw-detail attribution without paired evidence.
uncertainty: Patient bootstrap jointly resamples all images and both repeated predictions, not independent repeated images. It does not cover all fit uncertainty or prior search multiplicity.
external_test_policy: No external images, predictions or metrics loaded.
